text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. Start by planning your tasks and setting a realistic schedule. Prioritization is also important, so focus on the most urgent and important work first. Scope management helps you avoid taking on too much; if a task is too big, break it into smaller steps or agree on a smaller result. Finally, communication is key. If you think you may miss a deadline, tell your team or manager early. They can offer help or adjust the plan. By managing your time, priorities, scope, and communication, you can reduce stress and meet deadlines more successfully.
